signIn.heading: Your constraints once. The week's menus, every week.
signIn.body: Who eats here, the allergies, what nobody likes: you say it once. After that the week turns up already filled in — seven days, lunch and dinner. All that's left is to say whether it suits you.
signIn.privacy: We only ask for your email and name. No password is ever stored.
signIn.eyebrow: No more “what are we eating tonight?”
signIn.reassurance: Three questions, and the first week appears.
signIn.proofHeading: A week, exactly as it comes out
signIn.proofVariant1: Marceau — portion taken out before salting, then blended
signIn.proofCaption: Two dinners, the same vegetables and the same aromatics — bought once, and Marceau's portion comes from them too. You never thought about it: that is the point.
signIn.step1Body: The names, the ages, the allergies, the foods nobody touches. After that you never go back to it — unless you change your mind.
signIn.step2Title: The week turns up filled in
signIn.step2Body: Seven days, lunch and dinner, proposed in one go. No more deciding at six in the evening in front of the fridge.
signIn.step3Body: Turn a dish down and say why: the reason becomes a constraint, and the question stops coming back.
signIn.guestsLead: And when you have people over.
signIn.guestsBody: Six on Saturday evening, two of them four-year-olds: say so, and the meal is worked out for them as well — quantities included.
signIn.bodyShort: Who eats here, the allergies, what nobody likes: you say it once. After that the week turns up already filled in — seven days, lunch and dinner.
signIn.step1BodyShort: The names, the ages, the allergies, the foods nobody touches. After that you never go back to it.
signIn.step2BodyShort: Seven days, lunch and dinner, proposed in one go. No more deciding at six in the evening.
signIn.step3BodyShort: Turn a dish down and say why: the question stops coming back.

common.quotaExceeded: This household has reached its limit of suggestions for today. It frees up progressively — try again later.

account.feedback: An idea, a problem? Tell us

lifeStage.hint: Baby up to around 18 months, young child up to 11. You can change it at any time.

onboarding.heading: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Three questions, then on to the week. You can change everything afterwards.
onboarding.membersHint: A first name is enough. Add at least one person.
onboarding.allergiesLocked: Add a person first: an allergy belongs to someone.
onboarding.dislikesHint: Optional, and for the whole household. Separate with commas. You can narrow it down to one person later.
onboarding.needsMember: Add at least one person before continuing.

home.weekPendingBody: Onboarding is done. The week grid and generation are the next screens being built.

plan.violationsHeading: {count, plural, one {One meal could not be completed} other {# meals could not be completed}}
plan.violationsBody: They are marked in the week. You can regenerate them or write the dish yourself.
plan.generationLost: The generation did not arrive. Try again.
plan.noMembers: Add at least one person before generating a week.
plan.planViolationBody: The model suggested the same dish too often. Generate again, or replace the repeats yourself.
plan.sourceLinkLabel: View “{title}” on the original site (new tab)
plan.notPlannedBody: The catalogue holds no recipe suited to a baby under 18 months. Those meals stay yours to make.

favorites.heading: Your favourites
favorites.help: The dishes you want to see again. To put one in the week, open the meal it belongs to: your favourites are offered there, beside the suggestions.
favorites.emptyBody: Open a meal of the week and add a dish to your favourites: it will be offered back here, and in every slot, beside the suggestions.
favorites.emptyRule: Only dishes that come from a recipe can be favourited. Dishes the model proposed on its own have no page to come back to, so no heart.

exclusions.heading: Set aside
exclusions.help: They no longer come back in your weeks or in the suggestions.

shoppingList.title: Shopping list
shoppingList.selection: {meals, plural, one {# meal} other {# meals}} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Empty cells are meals with no dish.
shoppingList.unparsedHelp: Copied exactly as the recipe writes them. We cannot group them, so we do not try.
shoppingList.missingRecipe: One dish in this selection has no recipe: its ingredients are not on the list.
shoppingList.scaleNote: Quantities are the ones from the original recipes, for the number of portions they state. They are not adjusted to your household.
shoppingList.textHeading: Shopping — {range} ({meals, plural, one {# meal} other {# meals}})
shoppingList.textScaleNote: Quantities from the original recipes, not adjusted to the household.

composer.collapsed: Anything to note for this week?
composer.label: Tell us what matters this week
composer.placeholder: We're barely home this week, Tuesday I get back late, there's chicken left over, and it's been a while since we had pulses.
composer.understoodNothing: Nothing specific picked up. You can generate as is.

playful.2: Trying not to repeat last Tuesday…
playful.3: Looking for a dish everyone agrees on…

waiting.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
waiting.stillCooking: Your week is still being prepared.
waiting.stillCookingBody: It will show up here on its own: nothing is lost, the generation finishes without you.
waiting.failed: The generation did not go through.

panel.title: {meal} slot
panel.elseHint: Say why: the reason becomes a constraint, it is not thrown away.
panel.reasonPlaceholder: no fish on Tuesday, takes too long…
panel.alternativesHint: Candidates the pre-filter kept and the model passed over. No model call, instant.
panel.alternativesEmpty: No other recipe fits this slot.
panel.clearHint: Removes every dish from this meal. Useful when a habitual meal has to make way for an invitation.
panel.reportHint: If the problem is the recipe itself, not your taste. Someone will look at it.
panel.noAdaptationBody: This favourite replaced the proposal; their portion was not recomputed.
panel.noAdaptationWay: Asking for something else on this meal would compute one — but it would change the dish too.
panel.allergenOverridden: {name} does not eat {allergen}. You chose this dish despite the warning.
panel.allergenOverriddenHousehold: Nobody here eats {allergen}. You chose this dish despite the warning.

invitation.intro: The invitation is saved, then a meal is suggested for that slot. The invitation then stays beside the week's plan.
invitation.guestsHint: They are never stored as members: their age group is what portions need, nothing else is kept.
invitation.tastesHint: A soft signal, like a household aversion: it steers the suggestion, it excludes no dish.
invitation.noGuarantee: For this meal nothing is guaranteed beyond what you declared. Ask your guests.
invitation.stageMatters: The stage matters: “4 people” does not say whether that is four adults or two adults and two five-year-olds.
invitation.saveHint: The invitation is saved first: if the suggestion fails it still stands, and the meal can be generated again later.
invitation.removeHint: The dish stays in the plan: it may well suit. Emptying the slot is done from the meal panel.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.constraintsHint: A dislike can apply to the whole household or to one person. An allergy always belongs to someone.
settings.slotsHint: Tick the meals you want to see in the week. This is a household grid, not a per-person one.
settings.snacksHint: No effect in V0: the snack is a distinct object, planned for later.
settings.supportHint: Quote it if you report a problem: it is how we find your week. It is not a secret and it grants access to nothing.
settings.operatorHint: The catalogue, what households report, and who may operate the instance.
settings.operatorHintContributor: Classify the recipes nobody has sorted, and act on what households report.

admin.heading: Administration
admin.intro: Catalogue quality, as households meet it: what was never classified, and what they report.
admin.remaining: {count, plural, one {# recipe to classify} other {# recipes to classify}}
admin.done: Nothing to classify. Everything servable carries a type.
admin.shortcut: Choose with the keyboard: keys 1 to 8.
admin.withdrawHint: When no type fits: a dead link, a page that is not a recipe.
admin.reportsIntro: Households say these recipes are at fault. Retag, withdraw, or dismiss if the report was mistaken.
admin.queueIntro: These recipes carry no meal moment. Without one, a sweet tart can be offered on a Thursday evening. The ingredients almost always settle it.

operators.heading: Who may operate
operators.intro: A contributor classifies and withdraws recipes. An owner can also grant and remove that right.
operators.grantIntro: Ask them to sign in, then to send you the code shown in their Settings. No email address is stored: the code is the only way to name somebody.
operators.contributorNote: Only an owner can grant or remove this right.

error.unknownCode: No household carries this code. Check how it was copied.
error.malformedCode: Not a support code: eight hexadecimal characters expected.
error.conflict: Refused: either two households share this code, or this is the last owner — without one, nobody could grant access again.

households.heading: Households
households.intro: Who is here, what each one spends, and the two sanctions: cap the spend, or cut an access off.
households.searchHint: The code a customer gives you. Eight characters, dashes optional.
households.found: {count, plural, =0 {No household carries this code.} one {One household carries this code.} other {# households share this code.}}
households.busiest: {count, plural, =0 {No households yet.} other {The # households that called the model most over {hours} h.}}
households.limitHint: Default: {defaultLimit}. Zero stops generation without erasing the weeks already produced.

error.malformedCode: Not a support code: eight hexadecimal characters expected.
